Specification: EPFailureDetector: An eventually perfect failure detector for a set of processes. Each process maintains a suspicion set, per-pair delta timeouts, fromLastHeard counters, a local clock, and outgoing messages. Actions SendAlive, Receive, and Predict implement the detection logic: sending heartbeats at SendPoint intervals, updating suspicions at PredictPoint intervals, and adjusting delta on false suspicions.
